BOOK ONE · LESSON 140

He wants to know if/why/what/when

他想知道是否/为什么/什么/什么时候

A picture lesson on indirect (reported) questions. Six pictures show different scenarios: if a man is a teacher, why Mary teaches here, if a girl speaks English, what Graham is writing, if they are coming soon, when she is leaving. The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 139 dialogue), B (write 'He/She wants to know if/why/what/when...' sentences), and C (answer questions with indirect questions). The workbook drills indirect-question completion and open-ended 'Situations'; the grammar workbook completes indirect-question dialogue items, rewrites direct questions as indirect questions, and writes short reports with indirect questions.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

1. Sue: Is that man a teacher? → Sue wants to know if that man is a teacher.
2. John: Why does Mary teach here? → John wants to know why Mary teaches here.
3. Ben: Does that girl speak English? → Ben wants to know if that girl speaks English.
4. Julie: What is Graham writing? → Julie wants to know what Graham is writing.
5. Gary: Are they coming soon? → Gary wants to know if they are coming soon.
6. Jim: When is she leaving? → Jim wants to know when she is leaving.

1. 苏：那个男人是老师吗？→ 苏想知道那个男人是否是老师。 2. 约翰：玛丽为什么在这里教书？→ 约翰想知道玛丽为什么在这里教书。 3. 本：那个女孩会说英语吗？→ 本想知道那个女孩是否会说英语。 4. 朱莉：格雷厄姆在写什么？→ 朱莉想知道格雷厄姆在写什么。 5. 加里：他们很快就要来吗？→ 加里想知道他们是否很快就要来。 6. 吉姆：她什么时候离开？→ 吉姆想知道她什么时候离开。
